memory_curator.reason: Legacy-only. New Moment ingestion no longer gates source preservation through Curator.

weekly_digest.reason: First evidence-linked periodic summary; preserves one-off emotion and counterexamples without replacing raw Moments.

companion.reason: Exclude the current turn from past evidence and forbid describing it as an earlier question.

orchestrator.reason: Routes simple factual questions and complex temporal or pattern analysis.

temporal.reason: Orders stages, changes and reversals without treating the newest record as the whole history.

pattern.reason: Finds repetition and return signals while separating correlation from causation.

verifier.reason: Checks unsupported motives, causal strength and event frequency in addition to grounding.

synthesizer.reason: Avoids adding motives, causality or frequency labels beyond verified evidence.
